ruling: Teferi does not get two loyalty activations just because two heads share a turn. Plea opponents can each choose knowledge, tie two friendly time votes and force draw-three. Chronologist triggers once at opposing shared end step, not once per head.

prerequisites: Actual attack/connection as printed, legal attachment/control, own available mana resources, instant removal/countering trigger can interrupt.
pricing_implications: Proposed Nature Will four, Umbra/Sword/Repository three; no commander-pair premium. Controllers determine resources, not team-wide mana sharing.
ruling: Nature Will checks creatures its own controller controls and untaps that controller lands. Bear Umbra grants a triggered ability to enchanted creature: teammate creature means teammate controls trigger and untaps teammate lands. Sword trigger remains on equipment: A Sword on B attacker untaps A lands. Repository counts own attacking creatures and mana goes to its controller.
